text_block_list.text:
—On our way back from going out. To reward 
her for her daily hard work, we stopped by 
a popular cake shop, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a trendy shop... After 
waiting in line for 30 minutes, I'm 
finally at the front.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're wildly popular, 
limited-edition cakes! Every time I pass 
by here, my heart aches with longing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—*Ahem* No, just a little. Truly, I was 
only ever so slightly curious.

text_block_list.name: Ponytail Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah! It's finally our turn! I'm getting all 
fidgety from the guilt!

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's like three bowls of ramen worth of 
calories! I'm so glad I worked hard to cut 
weight~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Wh-Wh-Wh-What should I do...! I haven't 
prepared anything like that at all...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Splendid work! To have such an accurate 
grasp of my weight—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
E-Even after all this time... That's 
somehow kind of embarrassing in its own 
way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-It is nothing. Just speaking to 
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In any case, now I can enjoy it with peace 
of mind. Fufu♪ I can hardly wait!

And so, I enjoyed delicious cake together 
with Mejiro McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hah! ...Y-You're right. I should still 
have plenty of time even after eating...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Three servings of noodles should be about 
1,030 calories. Which means if I run for 
about two hours...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No... taking the soup into account, let us 
add another uphill dash.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And for cooldown, a jog worth three slices 
of chashu...! Just perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now we can truly savor it with peace of 
mind. Let us relish it thoroughly and 
execute our plan with precision.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Running off three bowls of ramen...!

After that, Mejiro McQueen and I went on a 
run worth exactly three bowls of ramen.
